body:
changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6939-filter-builder-mirror.md`

- names `content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx` → `content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx` — edited by this change

  > 1. **`FilterFieldSchema` required `name`.** Every read site matches an entry by `value` — `fields.find((f) => f.value === …)` in `getOperatorsForField`, `changeField`, `getInputType` and `renderValueInput`, `fields[0]?.value` in `addCondition`, and `ANGLE-BRACKETS(SelectItem value={field.value})` in the field dropdown (`packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`). `name` had zero read sites, and `FilterBuilderProps.fields` in that same file already declares `ArrayANGLE-BRACKETS({ value, label, type? })`. `@object-ui/fields`' `deriveFilterFields`, the real producer that builds this list from an object schema, emits `value` too, and the published doc (`content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx`) has declared `value: string` all along. 2. **Its `type` enum was `string | number | date | boolean | select`.** `string` is a phantom, and `text`, `datetime` and `time` — three of the six `FilterValueFamily` members the component folds a column into — were all refused. 3. **`FilterGroupSchema` was `{ operator, conditions }`.** The gate is `isValidGroup`, which tests `Array.isArray(v.conditions)` and `v.logic === "and" || v.logic === "or"` and nothing else.

### `.changeset/7562-filter-field-type-fourteen-members.md`

- names `content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx` → `content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx` — edited by this change

  > **What was wrong.** One authoring surface had three declarations that disagreed. The published doc (`content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx`) offers fourteen `type` members and marks the key optional; the renderer follows the doc — it buckets all fourteen by name and reads `fieldType || "text"` when the key is absent; this mirror offered seven and REQUIRED the key. So a `fields` entry written against our own documentation, which the component renders correctly, was refused by our own validator. The ruling made the published doc the authority: a contract does not retract what it published to authors.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `9eea12a2b` (merge-base with origin/main): 12 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1420 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2000 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36102048720)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `152f9351a8c64867ade9fdadaca85f5956a55cc9`

### ① Derived judgments

Instruments. Card objectui#8235 body and its three comments (triage comment 5568115575 is the binding ruling; the os-dev-report was not used as evidence); PR objectui#10515 body, REST file list and check-runs at the head; the diff `bc4efba7..152f935` read through git only (merge-base of `refs/review/pr-10515` with `refs/review/main` is `bc4efba732a31acd206066104a3210d1ec9379ed`, the same BASE the PR body names); the zod twins and TypeScript twins at the head (byte-identical to BASE: `git diff --stat` over `packages/types/` across the range is empty); the objectui#7340 pin; `AGENTS.md` (版本号策略 and line 168) and `.changeset/config.json`. The diff consumes no `@objectstack/spec` symbol, so the installed spec was not needed. No runtime `safeParse` probe was run: the shared tree carries no `node_modules` and installing is out of bounds for this seat, so every judgment below is a static reading of the head blobs. Every arrow in a type below is spelled `⇒`, and generics are spelled `Promise OF void`, to keep tag-shaped fragments out of this record.

Shape of the diff: 12 files, all `content/docs/components/**/*.mdx`, +36 / −9, one commit `152f935` on `claude/issue-8235-docs-handler-key-rows`. The REST file list agrees file by file.

**1. Classification pass first** — triage: "Whoever takes this does the **classification pass first**; ⛔ do not treat 17 as the defect count." Done, and re-derived here rather than taken from the PR body.

- Census. The card's regex, run as `git grep -E` over `content/docs/components/` at BASE and at HEAD: 16 rows at each, identical row texts, only line numbers move. The card's 17th row, `feedback/toast.mdx`, has no `on*` row at BASE (the card's sha `f57ca757b` is not in this clone, so the card-time count is unverifiable; at BASE the row is absent). PR body: RIGHT.
- Refusal set at head: 98 `handlerKeyRefusal(` calls in `packages/types/src/zod/*.ts` outside `tombstone.zod.ts` (a raw grep returns 99 lines; one is the comment at `feedback.zod.ts:118`), naming 50 distinct keys. PR body's "98 / 50": RIGHT. The card's 34-key list is stale, and the card's "`onNodeClick`, which no `handlerKeyRefusal` call names" is wrong: `data-display.zod.ts:599`, inside `TreeViewSchema`, refuses it as `'runtime-slot'`. The PR's correction of the card: RIGHT.
- Per-row attribution, each arm to its enclosing `export const`; all twelve are `'runtime-slot'`:
  - `AccordionSchema.onValueChange` — `disclosure.zod.ts:43` (card-confirmed).
  - `ToggleGroupSchema.onValueChange` — `disclosure.zod.ts:121` (the card cited `:78`; the file has moved, same arm).
  - `PaginationSchema.onPageChange` — `navigation.zod.ts:206` (card cited `:115`; moved, same arm).
  - `TreeViewSchema.onNodeClick` — `data-display.zod.ts:599`.
  - `ButtonSchema.onClick` — `form.zod.ts:214`.
  - `DatePickerSchema.onChange` — `form.zod.ts:530`.
  - `InputOTPSchema.onChange` — `form.zod.ts:667` (its neighbour `onComplete` at `:668` is `'retired'`, and the page does not document it).
  - `FormSchema.onSubmit` — `form.zod.ts:989`.
  - `FilterBuilderSchema.onChange` — `complex.zod.ts:544`.
  - `MenuItemSchema` command arm `.onClick` — `overlay.zod.ts:446`, consumed by `DropdownMenuSchema.items` (`:468`), `ContextMenuSchema.items` (`:507`) and `MenubarMenuSchema.items` (`:539`): the three menu pages.
  12 admitted, 3 on the nested item, 9 on top-level schemas. RIGHT.
- Not refused, left as they are: `ViewSwitcherSchema.onViewChange` (`views.zod.ts:326`), `FilterUISchema.onChange` (`:367`), `SortUISchema.onChange` (`:401`) — each `z.string().optional()`, an event NAME, and the doc rows already spell `string`. RIGHT. (The `onViewChange` refusal at `complex.zod.ts:268` belongs to `CalendarViewSchema`; the PR did not conflate the two.)
- `ButtonGroupButtonSchema.onClick` (`navigation.zod.ts:274`) is `'retired'` and `button-group.mdx:24` already spells `never`. Left as is. RIGHT.

**2. The remedy: an in-place annotation that keeps the callable type.** The card offered three per-row remedies ("deleting it, annotating it `never` the way `button-group.mdx` does, and moving it into prose the way `tooltip.mdx` does"); the triage made the choice editorial: "a per-row editorial call, not a contract decision, so it stays with the dev seat — ⛔ no contract review needed here." The PR chose a fourth form. Judged RIGHT, on grounds verified in the head blobs:

- `never` would be false on the TypeScript face. `HandlerKeyDisposition` (`tombstone.zod.ts:69-73`) defines `'runtime-slot'` as "the TS twin keeps its function type", and all twelve twins do: `navigation.ts:439` `onPageChange?: (page: number) ⇒ void`; `complex.ts:605`; `data-display.ts:1827`; `disclosure.ts:81` and `:351`; `form.ts:62` `onClick?: () ⇒ void | Promise OF void`; `form.ts:1129`; `form.ts:1960`; `form.ts:1407`; `overlay.ts` `MenuCommandItem.onClick?: () ⇒ void`. Contrast the `'retired'` shape `never` is for: `form.ts:1415` `onComplete?: never`, `navigation.ts:615` `ButtonGroupButton.onClick?: never`.
- Deleting a row or moving it to prose would break an existing pin. `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts` has a CONTROL block ("runtime-slot rows are NOT flagged — the blanket-sweep control") listing `pagination.mdx PaginationSchema.onPageChange`, `tree-view.mdx TreeViewSchema.onNodeClick`, `button.mdx ButtonSchema.onClick`, `input-otp.mdx InputOTPSchema.onChange`, and asserting each row is present and its type is not `never`. Four of the twelve rows are therefore constrained by a test outside this diff. That pin's `DOC_MEMBER_RE` requires the line to start (after at most 8 spaces) with the key, so a `// RUNTIME SLOT` comment line is not a row, and its owner walk-back only stops at `interface`/`type` declarations or headings, so the comment does not change attribution. The annotation leaves the pin green; test shards 1 to 8 are green at the head.
- The annotation is the validator's own message, compressed. `handlerKeyRefusal`'s `'runtime-slot'` text (`tombstone.zod.ts:109-123`) reads "A React host supplies it through the TypeScript interface / props, never through this validator, which refuses it by name", and its `remedy` reads "Author behaviour as a NODE TYPE instead — e.g. { "type": "toast", ... } or an action:button node with a declared action". `action:button` is a registered node type (`packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts:37`; rendered by `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-bar.tsx`). The two-line comment matches the style `button-group.mdx:24-25` already uses.
- One form on all twelve pages: `git grep -c 'RUNTIME SLOT (objectui#6124)'` finds exactly 1 on each of the twelve and 0 on every other page under `content/docs/`. Annotation lines at head: `pagination.mdx:27-28`, `filter-builder.mdx:64-65`, `tree-view.mdx:45-46`, `accordion.mdx:30-31`, `toggle-group.mdx:41-42`, `button.mdx:64-65`, `date-picker.mdx:34-35`, `form.mdx:50-51`, `input-otp.mdx:35-36`, `context-menu.mdx:36-37`, `dropdown-menu.mdx:39-40`, `menubar.mdx:37-38`; each sits directly above its row.

**3. The rewritten paragraph on the three menu pages** (`context-menu.mdx:59-62`, `dropdown-menu.mdx:61-64`, `menubar.mdx:61-64`). The deleted sentence, "Handlers are declared on the **item**, not on the menu: the shipped `MenuItem` declares `onClick?: () ⇒ void`", told a JSON author to write `onClick` on the item, which `MenuItemSchema` refuses. Replacing it is inside the card's defect ("an authoring `## Schema` block that a reader copies from"), and the new wording is the `alert-dialog.mdx:47` `onAction` sentence, transposed. RIGHT. The old sentence is gone from `content/docs/` at head (grep empty). One nit, not a defect: `MenuItem` is `export type MenuItem = MenuCommandItem | MenuDividerItem` (`overlay.ts:944`), and `onClick` is declared on `MenuCommandItem`, so "the TypeScript `MenuItem` interface" is loose — the BASE prose was equally loose ("the shipped `MenuItem` declares").

**4. Missing asks.** None found. Triage rulings honoured: classification first (done); "⛔ Out of scope, ⛔ do not fold in: the `pagination.mdx` `currentPage` / `pageSize` / `totalItems` drift" — untouched, that file's diff is the two comment lines only; the zod twins are not edited (the diff has no file under `packages/`).

**5. Done but not asked.** Nothing beyond the twelve rows and the three paragraphs. The `renderCellEditor` row in `data-table.mdx` (`DataTableSchema` refuses it at `data-display.zod.ts:455`, `'runtime-slot'`) is outside the card's `on*` instrument and was correctly left alone and reported rather than ridden in.

**6. Existing pins edited or deleted.** None — the diff touches no test, script or source file.

**7. New pins.** None added. Nothing guards a runtime-slot doc row's annotation (the 7340 CONTROL guards presence and callability only), so a later edit could strip these comments and every gate would stay green. Neither card nor triage asked for a pin, so this is not a missing ask; recorded for the seat.

### ② Semver level

No changeset file is in the diff. `AGENTS.md` line 168 owes a changeset only when a `fixed`-group package's published executable source, or one of its eight manifest contract fields, changes, and names `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s header as the authority when the prose and the script disagree. `content/docs` is a repo-root tree under no workspace package. I ran the head's script (byte-identical to the working-tree copy) over the exact range, `--base bc4efba732a31acd206066104a3210d1ec9379ed --head refs/review/pr-10515`: "12 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a manifest whose published contract moved, 0 under a package changesets ignores, 0 changeset(s) added. No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed", exit 0. CI "Changeset Declaration" is green at the head. 版本号策略's `major` ban is moot. Level: none, and correct.

Discrepancy recorded, not a defect: the brief's premise that a docs-only `content/docs/**` change "owes an empty-frontmatter changeset" is not what this repository's authoritative gate asks for; `AGENTS.md` defers to that gate, and neither the card nor the triage asked for one. Past docs-only changesets with empty frontmatter exist by convention (`.changeset/6132-undeclared-action-props.md` is one), but nothing enforces the convention. If the seat wants it, it is a one-file follow-up, not a semver error.

Changeset prose: none to read. The PR body's sentence "No changeset is owed" and the quoted script verdict: TRUE (the wording I obtained differs only by the words "source or published contract", which the PR body also quotes).

Docs prose the diff adds, sentence by sentence:
- Annotation sentence 1, twelve times: "RUNTIME SLOT (objectui#6124): a React host supplies it; JSON refuses it by name." TRUE on all twelve (attribution in ①.1; `handlerKeyRefusal` returns a `z.custom` whose predicate is a constant `false`, so any value is refused, and the message names the key). Nuance on the three menu pages: `MenuItemSchema` is a `z.union`, so the top-level issue is zod's `invalid_union` with the named refusal hanging off the command arm — the comment above `MenuItemSchema` in `overlay.zod.ts` records exactly this. "By name" holds at the arm; a consumer printing only top-level issues sees "Invalid input".
- Annotation sentence 2, twelve times: "Author behaviour as a node type, e.g. an action:button node." TRUE: it is the validator's own `remedy`, and the node type exists.
- Paragraph sentence 1, three times: "The item's `onClick` is a runtime slot a React host supplies through the TypeScript `MenuItem` interface; it has no JSON spelling, and the validator refuses it by name on the item." TRUE (TS: `MenuCommandItem.onClick?: () ⇒ void`; zod: `overlay.zod.ts:446`), with the interface-versus-type nit in ①.3.
- Paragraph sentence 2, three times: "The menu schema itself declares no authorable event slot either, so there is no menu-level `onSelect`." TRUE: `ContextMenuSchema` (`overlay.zod.ts:505`) and `MenubarSchema` (`:545`) declare no `on*` key; `DropdownMenuSchema` declares only `onOpenChange` as a refusal arm (`:474`), which is not authorable; no `onSelect` appears anywhere in `overlay.zod.ts`.

Pending changesets that name an edited file (claims gate run over the same range, exit 0, report-only): `6939-filter-builder-mirror` and `7562-filter-field-type-fourteen-members`, both about `FilterField.value` and `type`; this diff adds only two comment lines above `onChange` in `filter-builder.mdx`, so both paragraphs stay true. `6132-undeclared-action-props.md` also names the three menu pages, but its frontmatter is empty and the gate skips such bodies by rule (its exclusion 2), which is why the PR body's count of two is the gate's count. Its TypeScript-face claim (the item declares `onClick`) stays true after this diff; its `overlay.zod.ts:136` `z.function()` citation was already stale since objectui#6124, not by this change.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The PR body's own flags. (a) "This card's triage and the objectui#7340 CONTROL still disagree about runtime-slot rows": for this PR there is no conflict to settle — the triage made the remedy editorial, the CONTROL constrains four of the twelve rows to stay present and callable, and the chosen form satisfies both; any delete, prose or `never` remedy on those four would have to move the CONTROL in the same PR. (b) `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` "NOT MEASURED" locally: both run in CI's `doc-snippet-types.yml` (the "Doc Snippet Type Check" job runs `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` and, at its line 187, `check-doc-example-types.mjs`), success at the head; by construction neither reads a `plaintext` fence and no `SchemaExample` fixture changed. (c) `renderCellEditor` and the pagination drift: correctly out of scope. (d) "The census has no gate behind it": true. The dev report lists no open questions.
- CI at the head `152f9351a8c64867ade9fdadaca85f5956a55cc9`: 39 check-runs, all completed — 36 success, 3 skipped (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage shard …/4)`, `Test (coverage)`), 0 failure, 0 in progress. No re-poll was needed. The full test matrix ran (shards 1 to 8, about ten minutes each), consistent with `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` listing `filter-builder.mdx`, `context-menu.mdx` and `dropdown-menu.mdx` as test inputs, so the markdown fast path did not skip the suite.
- Draft: yes (`draft: true`).
- `Clause-②: no` holds: no file under `packages/` or `apps/` changes, no accept set, export or manifest moves, and the presence gate counts 0 published-source files in the range.
- Main under the PR's files: did not move. `refs/review/main` is `6881e9e47768c91cc7d7575777d987984aac20a4`, 11 commits past the merge-base `bc4efba7`; `git diff --stat` between the two over the 12 files is empty and `git log` over those paths is empty. GitHub's recorded `base.sha` `9eea12a2` lies between them (descendant of the merge-base, ancestor of main).
- Reads only: no GitHub writes, no MCP tools, no checkout or edit of the shared tree.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-8235-docs-handler-key-rows`
Reviewed-by: `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`

**VERDICT: PASS**
